preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 50.
The number of students N must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of connections P must be at least N-1 and at most 100000.
The number of queries M must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and 1 <= d <= 1000000 for u, v, d in connections)
preconditions.description: Each connection must have valid computer indices and a positive distance.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid computer indices.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the case number.
The output must contain M lines of results plus one line for the case number.
Each result must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum length of cable.
